en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Musa Bin Bakr who said,
‘For everything is Zakaat, and a Zakaat of the bodies is the Fast’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘
Everything has a cleanser; the cleanser for bodies is fasting.”
